notes:
Read all 1,054 lines of the markdown conversion, including Appendices A-E. The source of record for this check is the 58-page September 22, 2023 HBS Working Paper 24-013 / SSRN 4573321 saved locally, not the 2026 Organization Science version of record. All recorded quotations were checked against PyMuPDF text extraction from the stated PDF pages; only whitespace and line breaks were normalized, and duplicated statements are identified by their locators.

No public participant-level dataset or code deposit for S1 or S2 was located. The only study-linked repository URL is the OSF preregistration, whose metadata/files require credentials in the tested API. The overall status 'restricted' describes that inaccessible research artifact; it does not establish that participant data have been deposited there. The paper does not say that participant data or code are available on request: its request/embargo statement applies specifically to the preregistration. Current raw-data availability therefore remains unconfirmed.

The form's data_and_code.data_url and code_url are both empty. No additional repository or code URL was identified in the paper. Appendices A-B supply task instructions and a grading rubric in the paper; references to attached interview files and Excel spreadsheets concern materials provided to participants, not a posted participant-data archive. Appendices C-E provide methods, aggregate figures and illustrative interactions, without an accessible participant-level file inventory.

The publisher's landing page returned HTTP 403 with a bot challenge, including via the article DOI, so the latest article and its supplementary-file links could not be checked. The paper's repeated https://ssrn.com/abstract=4573321 link also returned HTTP 403 after redirecting to https://www.ssrn.com/abstract=4573321, with the same type of bot challenge. No attempt was made to bypass either block.

All six distinct HTTP links embedded in the PDF references were also requested: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4539836 (PDF p. 26), https://ssrn.com/abstract=4246077 (p. 26), http://dx.doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.4246077 (p. 26), https://ssrn.com/abstract=4414065 (p. 27), https://ssrn.com/abstract=4526071 (p. 27), and https://ssrn.com/abstract=4375283 (p. 29). Each returned HTTP 403 and ended at the corresponding www.ssrn.com abstract page with a bot challenge. These citations concern other papers and were not counted as deposits for c051.

Search counts are the API-reported total hits for each recorded query; null denotes a failed request or an uninspectable publisher page, not zero matches. Search-result metadata were reviewed to exclude unrelated papers/datasets. The DataCite and Zenodo keyword searches can return citing publications. No matching data deposit was identified through either title variant or the first-author searches. The access failures and older saved paper limit confidence in a negative finding.

No participant data file was read, so no row count, columns, arm labels, scores, text availability or data license could be verified. Public data found in this check cannot resolve final.open_items: per-arm analyzed counts or attrition/randomization counts for either experiment; the numbers of subjects and ideas in the similarity analysis; numerical similarity contrasts or idea-list creativity statistics; or the identity of the idea-list rater. Per-person and arm-level means, SDs, SEs and text-based diversity measures cannot be computed from a confirmed public deposit. The version-of-record and reviewer-judgment items also remain unresolved.
